security_audit.summary: Twenty-three alerts are false positives involving Markdown backticks, documentation links, framework names, and ordinary project testing. One alert identifies a real data-loss risk: the skill recommends resetting the local database with confirmation bypassed. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, or data exfiltration.

remediation.issue: The database reset command uses --yes without requiring confirmation or checking whether local data is disposable.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit approval before resetting data, verify an isolated test database, and remove --yes unless the user authorizes noninteractive deletion.

content.user_title: Test Void Apps with Hono CLI
content.value_statement: Void page actions can return HTTP 200 even when validation fails, making status-only tests unreliable. This skill guides Hono CLI checks of responses, redirects, and client interactions.
actual_capabilities: Guides Hono CLI installation and route discovery while excluding internal Void routes.
Explains how to request page data using the x-voidpages header.
Provides batch testing guidance with per-step status and response-body assertions.
Explains how to capture redirect locations and reuse them in later requests.
Guides happy-dom form filling and clicking with final URL, text, form values, and console inspection.
Documents named page actions, validation error responses, and Origin header behavior.
limitations: Provides instructions and examples, not a bundled test runner or application.
Requires a compatible Void project, Hono CLI, and happy-dom for client interaction checks.
happy-dom does not provide layout or CSS rendering for visual verification.
Examples require adaptation to project routes and fields; the suggested database reset can delete existing local data.

use_cases.title: Verify Page Action Changes
use_cases.description: Check validation messages and successful submissions after changing a Void page action.

use_cases.title: Investigate Client Interaction Failures
use_cases.description: Inspect form values, console errors, and final URLs after simulated form submissions.

use_cases.title: Review Route Behavior
use_cases.description: Discover application routes and verify page data, named actions, and redirect handling before accepting changes.

prompt_templates.title: Discover Routes
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect my Void project and list application routes with Hono CLI. Exclude internal routes and do not change application data.

prompt_templates.title: Check Validation Responses
prompt_templates.prompt: Test validation for [page route] using Hono CLI and x-voidpages. Assert response error fields, not only status codes. Use an isolated test database.

prompt_templates.title: Test a Redirecting Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Hono batch test for [create action] followed by its destination. Capture the Location header and assert each step. Use disposable test data.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate a Client Regression
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare HTTP checks and Hono browse results for [form route]. Inspect final URL, form values, visible text, and console errors after submission. Do not reset data.

output_examples.input: What should a validation test check when a Void page action returns HTTP 200?
output_examples.output: Check the response error fields as well as the status. A validation failure can return HTTP 200 with field messages in body.errors.

output_examples.input: How should I investigate a form that stays filled after submission?
output: Run a Hono browse interaction that fills the form and submits it.
Inspect the final form values, URL, visible text, and console errors.
Use a real browser separately when layout or CSS behavior needs verification.

best_practices: Discover actual routes and inspect a response before adapting example paths, fields, and validation messages.
Assert response bodies for validation failures and include expectations on every batch step.
Use isolated test data and obtain explicit approval before any database reset.
anti_patterns: Treating HTTP 200 as proof that a page action succeeded.
Using happy-dom results as evidence that layout and CSS render correctly.
Running database resets with confirmation bypassed against valuable local data.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it when testing a Void application with Hono CLI, including pages, page actions, and API routes.

faq.question: Does the skill include the required tools?
faq.answer: No. It documents installation of Hono CLI and happy-dom in an existing Void project.

faq.question: How do I request page data instead of HTML?
faq.answer: Send the x-voidpages header with the value true to request structured page data.

faq.question: Why does an invalid page action return HTTP 200?
faq.answer: Void page actions report validation messages in body.errors while retaining HTTP 200. Test those fields to detect validation failures.

faq.question: Can Hono browse verify visual appearance?
faq.answer: No. It runs JavaScript in happy-dom, which has no layout or CSS rendering.

faq.question: Is resetting the database required?
faq.answer: No. The skill suggests a reset between runs, but it can delete local data. Require explicit approval and an isolated test database.
